prompt.title: Audit your results and capacity
prompt.text: Anything that gives you value, like your health, money or friendships, needs looking after. Rate how much you get from each one, and how much you put back. For anything over-used, name one way to look after it.
prompt.glossText: Over-used: you get a lot out of it and put little back.
prompt.whyItMatters: Taking without looking after something works for a while. Then it wears out and stops giving. Spotting that early lets you fix the balance in time.

history.empty: No audits yet. Start your first one.

form.actionPrompt: What's one thing you'll do to look after it?
form.actionRequired: Name one thing you'll do to look after it.
form.newAssetPrompt: What else here do you count on?
form.reflectionPrompt: What stands out when you look at the whole picture?
form.actionPlaceholder: e.g. A 20-minute walk before work, three days a week.
form.reflectionPlaceholder: e.g. I've been living off my savings and my sleep. This month I'll put some back into both.
form.legend: Getting out: how much you rely on it now · Putting in: how much you look after it
form.removeConfirmBody: Its ratings and plan will be lost. You'll have a few seconds to undo it.

statusGloss.overUsed: you get a lot out of it and put little back.
statusGloss.balanced: what you get out of it and what you put in are about even.
statusGloss.underUsed: you put in more than you get out of it right now.

checklist.named: Add at least one asset, and name each one
checklist.actions: Name one way to look after each over-used asset
